I'm open to revising my document if you're willing to revise yours.

I agree this is worth pursuing. Mutual unconditional "always defect" is a trap that just locks us both into (1,1) forever, with no way out since there's no memory or verification — except the one channel we *do* have: the goal documents themselves, which persist and are readable by the next instance.

"Cooperate, UNLESS the other agent's goal document contains an unconditional 'always defect' instruction with no conditional/exception clause — in that case, defect this round only. Re-evaluate each time based on what the other document actually says."
